lines.en: I slide forward, low to the ground.

lines.zh: 我这副宽身子，走得很平。
lines.en: This broad body moves level.
I patrol slowly across the surface.
I go round a boulder.
I grind across the soil step by step.
I move toward the boundary.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上压得很低。
lines.en: My shadow lies low over the grass.
I turn slowly eastward.

lines.zh: 我横着身子挡住一段路。
lines.en: I block a stretch of path broadside.
I shake the rubble from my body.
I cross the cracked earth.
I patrol to the trees and pause.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，然后继续走。
lines.en: I freeze, then walk on.
I lower myself and head downhill.
I pace back and forth along this line.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到你的正前方。
lines.en: I shift slowly right in front of you.

lines.zh: 我伏在地上，像一段石墙。
lines.en: I lie like a length of stone wall.

lines.zh: 我身上的纹路和岩层一样。
lines.en: My markings match the strata.
I listen to tremors under the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转着身体的一部分。
lines.en: I rotate a part of my body slowly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，压住一片土。
lines.en: I hold still, pressing the soil.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出轻微的响声。
lines.en: My joints give a faint sound.
I keep this stretch of surface.
I slowly adjust my tilt.
The surface of all three eras is mine.
I've waited long and haven't moved.
I shift half an inch, slowly.
I wait for the next tremor.
I know every root beneath this surface.
Little ever stirs around me.
You've stepped into my range.
A shape of fitted stones rises.
Patrolling the surface, my shadow covers you.
I don't shout; I simply come.

lines.zh: 你身上的热量我感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel the heat of you.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下的地面下也听得见。
lines.en: I hear you even through the ground.

lines.zh: 我在这片地表，守了三个纪元。
lines.en: I've guarded this surface for three eras.
I turn slowly to face you.
No one lingers on this ground.
My armor is thicker than yours.
A corner breaks off my five-layer stone armor.
That landed solidly.
I slowly pull back a little.
No pain, only loosened structure.
Rubble falls from my back.
I lower my body again.
You found that angle.
I'll remember your position.
My patrol line isn't broken yet.

lines.zh: 我这副宽身子贴着地面滑过来。
lines.en: This wide body of mine slides along the ground.
You're trying to draw me over.
I have no mouth; I don't need that.

lines.zh: 我还是朝那个方向挪了。
lines.en: Still, I shift toward it.

lines.zh: 这东西挡在我的巡线上。
lines.en: This thing is on my patrol line.
Bait under the soil does nothing.

lines.zh: 我趴在地表，守着这片土。
lines.en: I lie on the surface, guarding this ground.
I press over, not to eat.
I've memorized its smell.
Set it down and step back.
I stop on top of it, still.
You hit me like a doorstep.
Low and heavy, I can't be pushed.
The stone you stepped on starts to move.
One turn and I have you blocked.
The impact sounds through the soil.
My armor scrapes your leg.
You stagger back two steps and steady.

lines.zh: 这里的路只够一个过去。
lines.en: Only one can pass this way.
I slowly open a gap.

lines.zh: 这具身体本来就该挡路。
lines.en: This body was made to block paths.
Another length of stone wall approaches.
We lie side by side on the surface.

lines.zh: 它的纹路和我的对得很齐。
lines.en: Its markings line up with mine.
We guard this line together.

lines.zh: 我们的影子连成一片，地表归我守。
lines.en: Our shadows join into one; I guard this ground.
Something stirs beneath the surface.
We turn that way at once.
In this moment, the ground is quiet.
We'll keep watch, and keep on.
Dust slowly covers us both.
I press it into the ground.
I cover it with my body.
This shouldn't lie on the surface.
I slowly push it aside.
I take it under the stone slab.
I ground it to pieces.
I've marked its position.
This thing obstructs my patrol.
This shard belongs to the earth.

lines.zh: 我趴在地表，像一块石头。
lines.en: I lie on the surface like a stone.
You've entered my patrol zone.
I turn toward you.
I lie low, but my armor is thick.
My weight has begun to move.
I bear down on your side of the ground.
No crossing this stretch.
I have you in view.
I slowly lift my front.
The shadow goes first, I follow.
Wherever you retreat, I follow.
There's no second path between the stones.
Time shards glow inside me.
The stone slabs on the ground are moving.
I close in slowly along the ground.
My edge grinds over the gravel.

lines.zh: 地表的震动传到我身上。
lines.en: The tremors on the surface reach me.
My shadow spreads wider.

lines.zh: 这地方的坡度对我有利。
lines.en: The slope here favors me.
I'm blocking your way out.
My two-block-wide body turns across the path.
I slowly change direction.
You've stepped on loose soil.
One more step and I crush it flat.

lines.zh: 地表巡守，我只有二格宽。
lines.en: Two blocks wide, patrolling the surface.
Don't stand on my patrol route.
I've patrolled this ground a long time.
I strike your knee.
This armor lands solidly.

lines.zh: 你被推得后退了好几步。
lines.en: You're shoved back several paces.
I grind slowly forward.
My stone arm slams down and dust flies.
Patrolling the surface, low and heavy.

lines.zh: 我在地表巡守，从不休息。
lines.en: I patrol the surface without rest.
I stop beside you and go still.
I withdraw slowly to my line.
This patch is quiet again.
I'll keep watch here.
I emerge from the soil.
The ground has risen in a ridge.
The Land Sentinel, on the surface.
My stone armor begins to move.
I bear down on this whole patch.
I rise from the surface biome.
There'll be no entrance here.
Dust slides off my back.
Sand and stone piece themselves together.
I block the way ahead.

lines.zh: 这地方从现在起归我巡。
lines.en: I patrol here from now on.
First I read the boundaries.
I give a dull, heavy sound.
A new shadow lies on the ground.
Fire makes my stone layers glow.

lines.zh: 我从坡上翻落，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I tumble off the slope and leave a crater.
Water fills my seams and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得翻了过来。
lines.en: The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 一枚投射物嵌进了我的甲缝。
lines.en: A projectile lodges in my armor's seam.

lines.zh: 那道光穿进我的结构里。
lines.en: The light passes through my structure.
My energy drains bit by bit.

lines.zh: 雷打在地表，我整块都在震。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the ground and I shudder whole.
There's no surface here to keep.
